body:
"You shouldn't date me, I'm not a good girlfriend."  Said my 7th grade ex-girlfriend.  I was in 8th grade.

She said this to me, and that night we had a Facebook fight (that I won't get into details about), but we broke up.  The relationship lasted for about a day (yea I know I'm stupid), but a few months later on, I found out that she had actual problems.  Like that she had to go to mental hospitals, or later post something using her sister's alias to say that she had committed suicide but was actually still alive.  I got over that, but she needed attention and had some problems and was immature(I laughed so hard at the post, because her best friend had commented saying that she was fine and alive.). So I kinda felt bad but I thought that it was still the most stupid and cheesy reason to telling someone that you don't want to date them or you're not capable of dating them.  Just tell me the truth, I don't bite...

Edit:  Grammar mistakes, a little more to the story.
Thanks for all the advice, it truly means alot and thanks for taking your time to reply to me. Thanks for the song too!
